fact: At the World Urban Forum in Cairo (4-8 November 2024) the Minister of Local Development said accurate databases of projects, assets, dues and arrears per governorate are still needed, and that the mechanised receipt has been approved under the financial inclusion system.
title: وزيرة التنمية المحلية: لدينا خطة للنهوض بموارد المحافظات الذاتية
